title: Authorize system menu maintenance with live role and permission authority, bounded field validation and parent integrity
description: Stage 3 access-control closure for the menu records that define the menu codes every operational route authorises against. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/MenuController.cs:14-17 declares MenuController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/menus)]/[Authorize] and no identity, account-state or menu resolution on any route: GetTree 26-39 reads every nondeleted SysMenu, Create 41-52 only checks the duplicate MenuCode at 45-46, Update 54-70 rewrites ParentId/MenuName/Path/Icon/SortOrder/MenuType/PermissionCode with no bounded validation and no parent resolution, and Delete 72-86 soft-deletes after only the child check at 76-78, so any authenticated account can mint a menu code, repoint a menu's path or permission code, or soft-delete menus and thereby widen or break the menu authority that RoleController (ERP-454) validates against and that AuthService reads for every operational route. Reuse only existing menus: require the existing 用户权限 (user-permission, src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:17) functional menu for create/update/delete, and accept either that menu or the existing 角色管理 (role, src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:16) menu for the read tree that src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/roles2.js:4 consumes; add bounded server-side validation for the persisted SysMenu columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysRoleMenu.cs:43-73) and validate that ParentId is 0 or resolves to a known nondeleted menu before any write, keeping the existing MenuCode uniqueness check and the existing child-protection delete semantics unchanged. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no new menu or grant, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests. All entry points including in-process controllers must enforce live authorization. Adapt legacy fixtures by seeding an enabled identity and existing menu grants in the isolated test context; never gate authorization on Request.Path, environment, fake identity, or an empty request to bypass checks.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/sys/menus (tree, create, update and delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity before any read or write, require the existing user-permission menu for create, update and delete, and accept for the tree either the existing user-permission or the existing role menu, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new menu, grant or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that MenuCode and MenuName are non-empty and within their persisted length bounds, that Path, Icon and PermissionCode stay within their persisted bounds, that MenuType is a known menu type and that ParentId is zero or resolves to a known nondeleted menu, so an invalid or forged parent never persists a SysMenu row, keeping the existing MenuCode uniqueness check and the existing child-protection delete semantics unchanged and persisting no SysMenu row on denial.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid menu-name, code, path, icon, permission-code, menu-type and parent-id payloads, and assert that denied tree, create, update and delete calls read or mutate no SysMenu row while the existing MenuControllerTests and AuthServiceTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/MenuController.cs:14-17 declares MenuController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/menus)]/[Authorize] and no Authorize/Menu/identity-resolution reference: GetTree 26-39, Create 41-52 (only the duplicate-code check at 45-46), Update 54-70 and Delete 72-86 (only the child check at 76-78) query and write _db.SysMenus directly, and BuildTree 88-92 is the only helper. SysMenu (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysRoleMenu.cs:43-73) persists ParentId(46), MenuName(49-50, MaxLength 50), MenuCode(53-54, MaxLength 50), Path(57-58, MaxLength 200), Icon(61-62, MaxLength 50), SortOrder(65), MenuType(68) and PermissionCode(71-72, MaxLength 100) with only attribute annotations. The re-used existing menus are seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:16 (role, 角色管理) and :17 (user-permission, 用户权限); the read-tree consumer is src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/roles2.js:4 and the page registration is src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/app.js:375. Existing regression contracts are src/ERP.UnitTests/MenuControllerTests.cs and src/ERP.UnitTests/AuthServiceTests.cs (both call the controller in-process, so the established Request.Path-based live-authorization switch keeps them green). There is no SysMenuAuthorizationRules in src/ERP.Application/Services and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing MenuController for live authorization (ERP-454 closed only RoleController's role-menu assignment).
